note: Every place two sources part, or one source parts with itself, and which way this package went. The data sheet is the only manufacturer document, so most entries are the data sheet disagreeing with itself or an implementation filling a silence.

order: the data sheet, read from the page image where its text layer and image differ, and from its own prose where a later hand retyped a page
SMS Power's notes, which cite data taken on an SC-3000H carrying a discrete SN76489AN
MAME, counted with SMS Power as one lineage for the noise register
authority.why: A manufacturer's sentence outranks an implementation. Where the data sheet contradicts itself, the reading that agrees with its own prose and block diagram wins.

documentSays.claim: Table 3 on page 3 prints NF0, NF1 as 0 0, 0 0, 1 0, 1 1 for N/512, N/1024, N/2048 and tone 3, so two rates share one setting.
documentSays.quote: The shift register will shift at one of four rates as determined by the two NF bits.

referenceSays.claim: MAME selects the three fixed rates with the two bits counting 0, 1 and 2.

thisPackageDid.claim: Reads the second row as 0 1, so the two bits count 0 to 3 through N/512, N/1024, N/2048 and tone 3.
thisPackageDid.why: It is the only reading in which four settings give four rates, and it agrees with the 2/4/8 selector page 8 draws.

divergences.wouldReopenIt: A printing of the data sheet with a different Table 3.

divergences.topic: Which bits of each byte carry F0 to F9 and A0 to A3.

documentSays.claim: Page 2 says F0 is the most significant bit and Table 1 weighs A0 at 16 dB; the pin table on page 5 names D0 the most significant data line. The data formats on page 4, retyped by a later hand, label the bits in the opposite order.
documentSays.source: TI SN76489AN data sheet, pages 2, 4 and 5

referenceSays.claim: MAME takes the low four bits of a first byte as the period's least significant bits and a value of 15 as off.

thisPackageDid.claim: Follows the prose and Table 1: the first byte's low four bits are the period's four least significant bits, the second byte's six are its most significant, and an attenuation of all ones is off.
thisPackageDid.why: The prose and the table are TI's printing; the retyped diagram is not.

documentSays.claim: The pinout on page 1 labels pin 6 OE; the pin table on page 5 and the timing on page 4 call it CE.
documentSays.source: TI SN76489AN data sheet, pages 1, 4 and 5

referenceSays.claim: Not modelled by MAME, which takes writes as calls.

thisPackageDid.claim: Folds the CE and WE handshake into write().
thisPackageDid.why: Every page but one calls it CE, and the model has no pins to name.

divergences.wouldReopenIt: A board that uses pin 6 as an output enable.

divergences.topic: When the shift register's bits reach the output after a noise write.

documentSays.claim: Nothing; the data sheet does not describe the register's width, taps or output.

referenceSays.claim: SMS Power describes a 15-bit register whose bit 0 is the output. MAME builds the same sequence in 17 bits with the output two shifts behind, so two zeros come out first after every write.

thisPackageDid.claim: Takes the output from bit 0 of the 15-bit register, with no delay.
thisPackageDid.why: SMS Power's pattern comes with a named measurement on a discrete SN76489AN. MAME's history attributes its delay to samples too, so the difference is two shifts that only a recording can settle.

divergences.wouldCloseIt: A recording of a discrete SN76489AN's output aligned to a noise write.

divergences.topic: What the registers hold before anything is written.

documentSays.claim: Nothing; the part has no reset pin and the data sheet describes none.
documentSays.source: TI SN76489AN data sheet, pages 1 and 5

referenceSays.claim: MAME clears every register, which leaves every channel at full volume, and notes that this needs testing on chips other than the SN76489A. SMS Power says discrete chips seem to start with random values.

thisPackageDid.claim: Scrambles every register, counter, flip-flop, the shift register and the latched address from a seed.
thisPackageDid.why: Nothing starts cleared in this family, and the one source that describes discrete parts describes them as random.

divergences.wouldCloseIt: Power a discrete SN76489AN repeatedly with no write and record its output.
